data.long_meaning: Derived from Susanna in the Old Testament, meaning 'Little Susannah'. Susanna was a beautiful and virtuous woman who was falsely accused of adultery and was exonerated by Daniel. The name Susy carries the meaning “Little Susannah” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Susy usually hope their child will grow to embody little susannah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Susy total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Susy or Susanna has a rich cultural history, particularly for people of the Christian faith. As we explored earlier, the name Susy is derived from Susanna, a character in the Old Testament and Hagiography of the Deuterocanonical Book of Daniel. Susanna was known for her beauty and virtue, yet she was falsely accused of adultery and faced a significant court trial to defend her reputation. This story has been retold in art, literature, and music throughout history, and the story of Susanna continues to inspire tales of resilience, strength, and integrity. Susy was also a popular name for Christian children during the early modern period and beyond, giving it a rich cultural heritage that continues to be celebrated.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Susy holds significance as a reminder of the importance of virtue and integrity. Susanna, the namesake, is a figure of resilience in the face of fraudulent accusations and a steadfast defender of her character. The story of Susanna provides an inspiration for individuals to stand up for their beliefs and values, even in the midst of adversity. The name also serves as a reminder of the power and importance of truth, as Susanna's accusers were ultimately exposed for their lies. Ultimately, the name Susy holds deep spiritual significance as a reminder of the virtues of truth, integrity, and resilience and serves as a powerful inspiration for individuals to strive for these qualities in their own lives.
